meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 项目管理专家与产品经理在做项目决策、技术评审或商业策略制定时，当需要多视角碰撞以打破思维局限，请用此技能模拟多智能体真实会议辩论，一键生成包含决策结论、核心论据与风险提示的完整会议记录，让复杂决策高效落地！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟多方辩论，一键产出含结论与风险的会议纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常陷于单视角决策，需要多方观点碰撞来拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Generate decision-ready meeting notes from a multi-perspective debate.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multi-perspective input before finalizing a project decision.

howto.what: 它会模拟 3~5 个不同专业背景和性格的 AI 智能体围绕一个议题开会，按开场、自由讨论、辩论、收敛、决策五个阶段发言，最后产出一份含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要从多个角度分析问题、让不同领域的专业知识相互碰撞，或想模拟一次团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 开一场会，讨论要不要把系统改成微服务架构
say.note: 先设计角色，再分阶段发言与辩论

say.text: 开一场产品定价策略会，角色包含产品经理和市场分析师
say.note: 产出方案对比与预期收益评估

say.text: 开一场项目风险评估会
say.note: 产出风险清单、影响评估与应对措施

howto.what_en: It simulates 3-5 AI agents with different backgrounds and personalities debating one topic across opening, discussion, debate, convergence and decision stages, then outputs a meeting record with the decision, key arguments and risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to analyze a problem from multiple angles, want input from different fields, or simulate a team decision discussion.

say_en.text: Hold a meeting on whether to move to a microservices architecture
say_en.note: It designs roles first, then stages the debate

say_en.text: Hold a product pricing meeting with a PM and a market analyst as roles
say_en.note: Outputs pricing options compared and revenue estimates

say_en.text: Hold a project risk assessment meeting
say_en.note: Outputs a risk list, impact ratings and responses
